subject.title: ACP parent session stuck until refresh when yielded waiting for child completion

question: What should be the canonical yielded-parent wake contract for #52249 across ACP, native subagents, give-up delivery, and heartbeat-disabled deployments?
rationale: Current main and open PRs show several plausible narrow repair paths, but choosing whether the permanent boundary is heartbeat-backed system events, a dedicated yieldWait lifecycle, or composed narrow fixes is a maintainer product/runtime decision.

options.title: Define One Cross-Runtime Wake Contract
options.body: Use #52249 as the umbrella and require narrow PRs to compose into one durable yielded-parent wake/resume rule across ACP and native paths.

options.title: Land Narrow Fixes Independently
options.body: Merge ACP, give-up, and top-level fan-out PRs as separate fixes while keeping this broad issue open until all covered cases are verified.

options.title: Split Into Canonical Sub-Issues
options.body: Close this only after maintainers choose narrower canonical issues that together cover heartbeat-disabled ACP, native delivery, and top-level drain behavior.

recommendation.title: Define One Cross-Runtime Wake Contract
recommendation.body: Use #52249 as the umbrella and require narrow PRs to compose into one durable yielded-parent wake/resume rule across ACP and native paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent heartbeat, task attribution, and subagent lifecycle history make this the best available owner for deciding the runtime boundary.
